SELECT typeof(l.TG) AS tg_type, MIN(l.TG) AS min_tg, MAX(l.TG) AS max_tg,
       MIN(p.Birthday) AS first_birthday, MAX(p.Birthday) AS last_birthday,
       COUNT(*) AS lab_rows, COUNT(p.ID) AS matched_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients
FROM Laboratory AS l
LEFT JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
GROUP BY typeof(l.TG)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-51 years')
LIMIT 1
